description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): For urgent situations in Korea: the emergency and interpretation phone numbers, the emergency rooms nearest a district, neighbourhood or place the user names (Korean name, address, class), or the contact details of the user's embassy where the site has them. The result is complete as given.

country.description: Optional. The user's country, for the embassy.

kind.description: Optional. Defaults to the phone numbers, plus emergency rooms when a place is given and the embassy when a country is given.

where.description: Optional. A district, neighbourhood or place name, e.g. "Hongdae", "Jongno-gu", "Haeundae Beach".

name: get_korea_emergency_help
title: Emergency numbers, emergency rooms, embassies
